blocks.text: Strangers in the Park 3 is the continuation of a series of 4×5 black and white portraits of total strangers, predominantly taken in New York City and London. I began the project in the summer of 2024.

The project has been a wonderful revelation for me… Not only rediscovering the simplistic beauty of large format portraiture but also providing me the opportunity to meet and get to know all kinds of people that I would normally never encounter.
And the images themselves have been at times surprising and even magical, as my subjects and I collaborate to make portraits that are both formal and intimate.
These images will be exhibited at Soho Photo Gallery in New York City, opening on November 5, 2026.
